The '''Grandmaster Council''' was the ruling political body of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. Based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gree/Legends|Gree]], all [[Grand council|planetary councils]] answered to this body.

==Overview==
The Grandmaster Council was the ruling governing body of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. Each planet in the Enclave was represented by a [[grand council]]; in turn each of these councils sent representatives to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] to sit on the Grandmaster Council. From the capital, the Grandmaster Council oversaw all [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] worlds and were the final authority in political matters in the Gree Enclave.<ref name="J8" />
